log.msg: lesson: extend-vs-compose verdict = NEITHER. Prototyped class Course extends Wizard (scratch, not landed) - flattening chapters into a flat steps array is a clean seam (initialize()), and free-navigation is a clean one-method override of step_button(). But Wizard's render()/update() each inline FOUR regions (rail-loop, crumbs, body, controls) with no per-region seam - adding a third region or grouping the rail by chapter forks both methods wholesale, and advance()/done()/finish() would hijack the reading column with Wizard's terminal summary() screen the moment the last lesson is reached, since Course has a completed SET not one terminal state. 7 of Wizard's 11 methods would need touching; the two that matter most for the 3440 headline (render, update) are full copies, not overrides. Course.js extends View directly - reuses ui/progress (bare element), ui/crumbs (css import), the .rail + .basis utilities (framework.css) for the three regions, zero new CSS classes minted.

assign.now: documentation pass done (readme.md, doc/decisions.md); verifying at 360/768/1280/3440 + interaction proof

log.msg: lesson: third region cost. Reusing .rail for BOTH the chapters nav and the next-up card was rejected - Page.css's width<38em rule sets order:-1 on EVERY .rail, so a second rail-classed element would jump ABOVE the reading column at narrow widths instead of staying below it (next-up teasing a lesson you have not read yet). Used .basis (framework.css, a fixed non-shrinking track) for the third region instead - zero new CSS either way, but the flex-1 reading column between them needed a floor (flex: 1 1 16em, inline) or it collapsed to a one-character sliver beside .basis's non-shrinking 18em on any row too narrow for both - ui-test's headless click found this, a static read did not. Screenshot before/after: ux-course-360.png.

lesson: what broke at 3440. Nothing overflowed, but .measure.start (Wizard's own flush-left convention) hugged the reading column against the rail and stranded the next-up card across a dead gap of blank page at full width - the same failure class Page.css's own comments warn about for unbounded tracks. Dropped .start so .measure's own margin-inline:auto centers the column inside its flex-1 wrapper instead - zero CSS of Course's own, just not opting out of the utility default. Money shot: ux-course-3440-money.png (fullscreen stage, all three regions); ux-course-3440-interaction.png proves the rail click updates both the reading column and the next-up card in one go(lesson) call.

assign.outcome:
**ux/Course landed — a chapters/lessons course, three regions that coordinate from one seam, extends nothing.**

![](ux-course-3440-money.png)

**Verdict (the brief's first question):** neither extends nor composes `Wizard`. Prototyped `class Course extends Wizard` first (scratch, never landed) — two seams held cleanly (flattening chapters in `initialize()`, free navigation overriding `step_button()`), but Wizard's `render()`/`update()` each inline four regions with no per-region seam, so a third region and a chapter-grouped rail would fork both wholesale, and `advance()` would hijack the reading column with Wizard's terminal `summary()` screen the moment the last lesson is reached (Course has a completed *set*, not one terminal state). 7 of 11 methods would need touching. Full evidence: [doc/decisions.md](/framework/ux/Course/doc/decisions/).

**What landed:**
- `public/framework/ux/Course/Course.js` — the class: `go()` `next()` `back()` `complete()`, rail/lesson/progress builders, zero new CSS (reuses `.rail`, `.basis`, `ui/crumbs`, the bare `<progress>` element)
- `public/framework/ux/Course/page.js` — [the live demo](/framework/ux/Course/) — a real 2×3 course on the framework's own template tier, click-through and complete proven headless
- [words](/framework/ux/Course/words/) — the same course wearing `ui-contrast ui-compact`, verified via computed styles (`--pad` 15.28px → 7.64px), zero of Course's own density/contrast lines
- `readme.md` + `doc/decisions.md` — the verdict, the rail/third-region calls, two real bugs found by driving it headless (a chapter-grouping bug that threw on click; a flex sliver that needed a floor) and the 3440 centering fix

**Proof, this task dir:** `ux-course-360.png` (honest full stack) · `ux-course-768.png` (third region wraps below) · `ux-course-1280.png` · `ux-course-3440-money.png` (fullscreen, all three regions) · `ux-course-3440-interaction.png` + `ux-course-select-lesson.png` + `ux-course-complete.png` (rail click updates the column *and* next-up; mark-complete moves the progress bar) · `ux-course-words.png`
